ko: [Title] MAIN_LOG_107_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]자, 마지막이야! 이것들만 적으면 끝낼 수 있어.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)](필기 소리) 슥슥~
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]왕실 공예의 기묘함은 일정 부분, 위에 장착된 고순도 오리지늄 결정에 의존한다……
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]마리아와 약속한 시간이 다 돼가는데, 잠시 브로치를 가져가도 될까?
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]그래…… 네가 망가뜨릴 리는 없겠지만, 그래도 따라가 봐야겠어.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]앗, 그러고 보니 마리아가 네 동생이었지?
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]그래.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]네 동생도 잠꼬대로 네 험담을 할까?
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]뭐? 그럴 리가……
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]그래? 너희들은 사이가 별로 안 좋나 보네.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]음?
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)](필기 소리) 슥슥~
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]오리지늄 회로에 의존하면 더욱 쉽게……
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]잠꼬대로 험담을 하면 사이가 좋다는 건가?
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]일종의 친밀감이지.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]어엿한 언니로서 동생 앞에서 다정한 모습을 유지하는 건 매우 중요하거든.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]그건 그렇고, 우리 집 꼬맹이는 뭘 좋아하더라?
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]에너지 저장 관련 공정은 너무 복잡하여 재현될 가능성이 없다……
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]마리아는 기계를 수리하는 걸 좋아한다. 애초에 장인이 되는 게 목표였고.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]그리고 과일 디저트도 좋아하지.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]우리 집 꼬맹이는 맨날 넘어지면 내게 찾아와서 위로받곤 해.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]마리아는 어렸을 때 내가 정원에서 훈련하는 걸 구경하는 게 가장 좋았다고 했지.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]……브로치라.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]……그만하지. 어스스피릿 씨, 우리 먼저 간다.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]……응, 응, 그래……
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]금방 돌아올게.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]알았어, 알았어. 위 내용을 종합해보면 연구의 중점을 기술 업데이트에 두는 게 좋을 것 같다……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)](필기 소리) 슥슥~
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]……됐어, 이거야.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]자 여러분, 보고서는 다 작성했어. 내가 제출할 테니 불은 꼭 끄고 가.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=2)]응? 다들…… 어디 갔지?
en: [Title] MAIN_LOG_107_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]Okay, final attack! Once I get these figures recorded, we can go.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)](Sounds of writing)
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]The crown jewel's workmanship is dependent to a certain degree on high-purity Originium crystals embedded in the surface layer...
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]I agreed to meet Maria soon. Do you think you could let me borrow the brooch, just for now?
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]Hm... I trust you wouldn't break it, but I'll go with you, just in case.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]Oh, yes. So Maria's your little sister?
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]That's right.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]So does the little scamp ever badmouth you in her dreams?
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]What? ...Of course not.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]Oh? Then it seems to me you aren't getting along very well.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]Hm?
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)](Sounds of writing)
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]Reliance on Originium crystal purity circuits can better...
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]Is speaking ill of someone in your sleep a sign of getting along?
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]It's a form of closeness, at any rate.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]As a role model for her, it's imperative that I maintain a kind image for her at all times.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]But what does our girl like?
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]...workmanship too complex w.r.t. energy storage, reproduction infeasible.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]She likes to repair machines. She's wanted to be a craftsman since she was a child.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]She's also fond of some fruits. In dessert form.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]Well, MINE comes to me for consolation every time she trips over her own jacket.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]Maria once told me that she loved watching me train in the garden more than anything.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]...The brooch.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]...We're done here for now, Earthspirit. We'll be leaving.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]...mm, fine...
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]We'll be back before you know it.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]Yes, yes, I heard you. Based on above, I believe research can be focused on technological renewal...
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)](Sounds of writing)
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]...Mm, and that's that.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]Alright, everyone, the mission report is all filled out. I'll go hand it in. Remember to turn the lights off when you leave.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=2)]...Hello?
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_107_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]よし、これで最後よ！　これらのデータを書き終えれば帰れるわ。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]（ペンを走らせる音）
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]皇族の工芸の精巧さはある程度埋め込まれている高純度源石結晶に依存しており……
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]もうすぐマリアとの約束の時間だな。そのブローチをひとまず貸してもらってもいいだろうか？
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]ええ……壊すことはないとは思うけど、一応一緒に行こうか。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]そうだ、マリアは君の妹だよね？
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]ああ。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]妹さんは寝言で君の悪口を言ったりする？
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]ん？　……言わないと思うが。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]ふぅん？　じゃあ君たちの仲もそんなに良くはないのかもね。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]ん？
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]（ペンを走らせる音）
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]源石結晶回路を使うことでより効率的に……
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]寝言で悪口を言うのは、仲が良い証拠なのか？
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]それは親密さの証しだよ。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]立派なお姉ちゃんとして、妹の前で優しいイメージを保っておくことはとても重要なことだけどね。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]にしても、うちのおちびちゃんは何が好きなんだろう？
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]……エネルギーチャージ面のシステムは、非常に複雑であり、再現は不能。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]マリアは機械修理が好きで、昔から職人になりたいと思っていたんだ。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]それとフルーツのデザートもだな。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]うちのおちびちゃんは服の裾を踏んで転ぶたびに、私に撫でろとせがむんだよ。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]マリアが子供の頃に一番好きだったのは、私が中庭で訓練する姿を見ることだったと言っていたな。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]……ブローチの話に戻ろうか。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]……そうだな、妹の話は終わりにしよう。アーススピリット、私たちは先に行くぞ。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]……ええ、わかったわ……
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]すぐに戻るよ。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]はいはい、聞こえたわ。以上の内容から、研究の重点を技術の更新に置くべきだと考え……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]（ペンを走らせる音）
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]……うん、これで問題ないわね。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]二人とも、任務報告は書き終えたわ。私は提出しに行くから、出る時に電気を消しておいてね。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=2)]……あれ、あの二人は？
